title: Where this week's Claude spend went

chat.text: Servex agents cost $1,408 (Claude $ at API prices) since Oct 1, computed from each agent's own log. Week is 75% used at 44% elapsed. Half went to minions, a third to the masterminds supervising them, an eighth to one-pass checkers; 474 of 563 agents have no recorded spawner, which is why the dashboard can't show who spawned whom.

add.title: The leaks, and what I'm doing
add.text:
1. **The supervision layer costs nearly as much as the work.** Task masterminds + masterminds = 37%; on data-grid the mastermind cost $14.82 against its minion's $10.09. **Change:** a small task (under ~$5) runs as ONE agent that does the work itself, no minion under it.
2. **Masterminds re-read huge contexts.** The $16 average mastermind is mostly cache reads of its own long history. **Change:** fresh session per task instead of a long-lived mastermind (already the rule for this tab).
3. **292 one-pass checkers** (clarity on every landing, reviewer on every merge): $172, 12%. **Change:** clarity only on owner-facing reports, not every landing.
4. **No spawner recorded** for 474 of 563 agents, so nobody can see who spawned whom. **Change:** every spawn records its parent; the Sessions tab groups by it.
5. **Pace:** 25% of the week left for 56% of the time. Only day-overview and message-cost run; everything queued waits for the reset (Oct 7, 9:59 pm).

message.text: Starting: reading the raw agent logs + registry to reconstruct the spawn tree, then building the cost-tree script, extending Sessions, and writing study.md. Single agent, no minions, budget $6.

Landed. The spawn tree is live, nested, and studied: Server/spend-tree.mjs builds it (1,906 agents, every spawner + trigger tag + own $/subtree $), the Sessions tab (/framework/ai/sessions/) shows it with a trigger filter and click-through to children, and study.md says reviews find a real fix 87% of the time — keep the review gate as-is. Clarity checks have no structured verdict yet to measure the same way; study.md says exactly what to add. Full outcome + links on the task page.
